title: Sudan's Army and the RSF Go to War in Khartoum
dek: Abdel Fattah al-Burhan and Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo, partners in the 2021 coup, fight for Sudan from 15 April 2023; the war splits the country and drives the world's largest displacement crisis.
body: UNHCR counts some 11.3 million people forced from their homes since the war began. Famine was confirmed in Darfur in 2024.

panels.label: Burhan Says
panels.text: Burhan says “we will neither forgive, nor compromise, nor negotiate” and that the war ends only if the RSF lays down its arms.

panels.label: Hemedti Says
panels.text: Hemedti says “the fight that we are waging now is the price of democracy” and that the RSF is fighting “radical Islamists.”

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: Each general says he is saving Sudan from the other; at stake is who commands its guns and its gold, and whether Sudan stays one country.
